newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas remains firm on storage buys.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas remains firm on storage buys.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices remained firm Thursday in the West amid active storage buying and a growing number of plant turnarounds, market sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was discussed mostly again in the low C$1.90s per gigajoule (GJ), though deals were also reported done at higher levels.
The strength in Alberta also filtered into the Sumas export market, where trades were confirmed done mostly in the mid-$1.50s per million British thermal units, up about five cents from Wednesday.
